title: The seven tests moved to the proof tier on 2026-11-17, run as proof tier
description: Seven Rust tests left the default run for the proof tier, by the user's decision on 2026-11-17 to retier what is over the tool tier's limits or runs JBMC or TLC: observations.rs's Box Office examples comparison, application_core_joint.rs's J1 quote family, application_core.rs's E1 and E2, and integration.rs's own-checker-against-JBMC agreement and its two TLC tests. Each passed in the default run earlier the same day; this runs them as the proof tier does (release, --ignored, by exact name), to show they pass there and what they take.
expected: exits 0: seven tests pass, none filtered away

resources.notes: alone in the test-fast profile the seven took 26, 77, 56, 32, 10, 1 and 4 s; most of the job is the release build of four test binaries

steps.name: the seven, by name
steps.run: JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 JVMCONTRACT_TEST_TIER=proof TEST_COST=proof cargo test --manifest-path lib/Cargo.toml --release --no-fail-fast --test observations --test application_core_joint --test application_core --test integration -- --ignored --test-threads 4 --exact box_office_examples_compare_as_their_boundary_diffs_say j1_the_quote_family_composes_the_four_streams e1_a_consumed_return_value_and_a_declared_failure e2_a_nullable_returned_dto the_tools_own_checker_agrees_with_jbmc_on_integer_proofs tlc_checks_the_box_office_model tlc_checks_temporal_properties_and_names_the_violated_one
